decade, I can tell you that this iPad mini is a gem!spanppspanDespite having used various models like the iPad Pro (2020, 12.9-inch, 2018 12.9 inch, 2016 9.7 inch), iPad (5th and 8th generation) and iPad Air (2021), the iPad mini has stolen my heart.spanppspanIt’s incredibly portable, fitting right in my hand and pocket, making it perfect for on-the-go use. Despite its size, it packs a punch, handling every task with ease. The battery life is fantastic, and using it with the Apple Pencil is a dream for note-taking and sketching.spanppspanThe only downside is the 60Hz display, which can feel like a step down if you’re used to higher refresh rates. I wish it was a 120Hz OLED. It can be a deal breaker for some people. Be careful if you think the display quality really matters to you and I suggest you go to an apple store and see the display before you make a buy.spanppspanDespite this drawback, i think overall, this iPad is a winner for productivity and portability. It’s a perfect companion for anyone seeking power in a small package.
